title: Close to airport and downtown!
description:
Whether you're an international traveler, a traveling nurse or visiting for fun, this is perfect! 7-10 minutes to downtown Nashville and hip Broadway, 3-4 mins. to the airport, we are so convenient everything, both for work and play.
The queen bed has a memory foam mattress for the best sleep ever.  Also a comfy memory foam queen sofa bed. The kitchen is fully stocked with cooking essentials, and the laundry room ready to use. 
Huge bathroom has a roomy shower.
 There is a $125 one-time pet fee.

Other things to note
The picnic courtyard is nice, several tables and an outdoor grill.
